name: DevCtl
description: Dev-control panel for the workspace: (1) a piloted browser — observes and controls the aw-app-browser container over CDP (aw-app-browser:9223), live screenshot, screencast over a WebSocket, navigate, click/type/key/scroll, evaluate/inject JS; (2) a tab relay — remote JS eval into the USER's OWN live browser tab (moved from the aw-workspace monolith, ADR "Apps Own Their Front + Back Routes" Decision 5), with a [dev] top-nav toggle and an agent-driven local /eval + /tabs escape hatch. Runs standalone too (Decision 4). Backend routes under /api/apps/devctl; a devctl-browser MCP tool wrapper (piloted-browser navigate/click/type/eval/screenshot) is contributed for agents via mcp.json.
